findings.obligation: Root TEST RULES: RTL name matchers are unanchored: anchor them (/^Add note$/) where a longer text could match. Non-blocking: the matcher is unanchored and the checks are vacuous only if a longer button label contains edit or delete.
findings.remediation: Anchor both matchers to the copy the sketch states for writers (for example /^Edit$/ and /^Delete$/), or to the exact control names once the crafter has them, so a longer label cannot pass silently.
